description: Quick rug check for a token on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or Solana: the 0-100 risk score, its level, a one-line summary and the top 3 reasons (mint, freeze, blacklist, fee or pause powers, upgradeable code, holder concentration, thin liquidity, a deployer with rugged launches). The full report at /token ($0.01) adds every reason, the facts behind it, price and liquidity, and change tracking. Rules-based, not advice. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

chain.description: Chain the token is on; defaults to solana for base58 addresses, otherwise base

name: token_quick_check
